Start simple
Most people only need one control mode, optional NFC/QR friction, and emergency unlock. Everything else is advanced fine-tuning.
Open FAQ & tips
Manual controls
Choose how the Home button and Quick Settings tile can control Switchly outside Mixed mode.
Schedule mode
Only schedules can auto-enable/disable Switchly.
Focus on calendar routines. NFC and QR actions are ignored while this mode is active.
NFC mode
Only NFC tags can auto-enable/disable Switchly.
Focus on physical friction. NFC actions are accepted for automation, including written tags and paired tags.
QR mode
Only QR actions can auto-enable/disable Switchly.
Focus on QR workflows. NFC and schedules are ignored while this mode is active.
Barcode mode
Only barcode actions can auto-enable/disable Switchly.
Focus on physical barcode workflows. QR, NFC and schedules are ignored while this mode is active.
Mixed mode
Use granular channel toggles for schedules, NFC, QR and manual controls.
Flexible mode with per-channel controls. Use the channel controls below to choose which control methods and active-access exceptions are allowed.

Quick Settings tile is disabled because manual controls are disabled in the current control mode.
Manual buttons are disabled by the current control mode.
Manual buttons can only enable Switchly right now. Use your allowed control method to disable it.
Control mode is locked while Switchly is on. Disable Switchly first, then choose a mode.
Allow schedule channel
Lets schedules enable/disable Switchly.
When enabled, schedule automations are allowed to change Switchly state while Mixed mode is active.
NFC control
Lets NFC actions control Switchly.
When enabled, NFC actions are accepted while Mixed mode is active, including written tags and paired tags. Other allowed channels continue to work too.
Allow QR channel
Lets QR actions control Switchly.
When enabled, QR control is allowed in Mixed mode.
Allow barcode channel
Lets barcode actions control Switchly.
When enabled, saved barcode actions are accepted in Mixed mode.
Manual controls
Let Home buttons and Quick Settings tiles enable and disable Switchly.

When enabled, Home buttons and Quick Settings tiles can fully control Switchly, including disabling it. Turn this off if manual controls should only start focus mode; the separate enable-only option will then be shown.
Enable-only manual controls
Let Home buttons and Quick Settings tiles enable Switchly while disabling still requires an allowed control method.
When enabled, Home buttons and Quick Settings tiles can turn Switchly on in any control mode. Turning it off still requires the currently allowed control methods.
Disable Switchly to edit control methods and access rules.
Allow picking apps
Lets you open app picker while Switchly is active.
Safety default is locked while Switchly is enabled. Enable this only if you intentionally want app list edits while protection is active, regardless of the selected control mode.
Allow managing profiles
Lets you manage or switch profiles while Switchly is active.
Safety default is locked while Switchly is enabled. Enable this only if you intentionally want profile management or switching while protection is active.
Allow schedule editing
Lets you add, edit, delete, and toggle schedules while Switchly is active.
Allow NFC tag writing
Lets you write and pair new NFC tags while Switchly is active.
Safety default is locked while Switchly is enabled. Enable this only if you intentionally want writing or pairing new NFC tags while protection is active, regardless of the selected control mode.
Block Switchly settings access
Lock Switchly screens while protection is active.
When enabled, Switchly settings and control screens are blocked while protection is active. Disable Switchly first (via an allowed channel) to change settings again.
Require NFC to disable Switchly
When on, only an allowed NFC action tag or QR fallback can disable Switchly.
Locked because “Require NFC to disable Switchly” is active.
How to unlock

Scan your NFC action tag to disable Switchly and unlock protected controls. If QR unlock is enabled, you can use your QR fallback instead. After unlocking, schedules and protected settings are editable again.
Enable paired NFC tags
Allows UID-only/read-only NFC tags and per-tag limits. Written Switchly NFC action tags still work without pairing.
Paired NFC tags

UID-only/read-only tag support is enabled. Pair tags in Manage paired tags to use them without writing a Switchly action, or to apply per-tag temporary-disable limits. Written Switchly NFC action tags still work without pairing.

Pairing is currently disabled.\nNormal written Switchly NFC action tags still work without pairing when NFC control is allowed.\nEnable this only for UID-only/read-only tags or per-tag temporary-disable limits.
Auto-pair written NFC tags
After writing a Switchly action to a tag, also add its UID to your paired tags.
Off by default. When enabled, writing a Switchly NFC tag will also store that tag UID as a paired tag. Use this only if you intentionally want writing and pairing to happen together.
When paired tags are enabled, you can manage optional limits in Paired tags.
Settings lock & temporary tags

Settings lock blocks opening Switchly settings and control screens while protection is active.\nTemporary disable actions give you a short time window (e.g. 10 minutes) before the previous protection state is restored.
Keeps blocked apps quiet.
Block in-app feeds
Master switch for in-app blocking surfaces
Uninstall protection
Makes App Info, uninstall paths, and Switchly-related system settings harder to use while Switchly is active.
Uninstall friction active

Switchly is making uninstall-related screens harder to access while protection is active. This is friction, not true uninstall blocking. Disable Switchly first via your allowed method if you want to continue.
Switchly settings protected
This system settings page could disable or weaken Switchly while protection is active. Disable Switchly first via your allowed method if you want to change these settings.
Filters notifications from apps that are currently blocked by your active profile. Requires notification listener access.
Allows one temporary unlock per day (15 minutes). During this window, Switchly is disabled so you can quickly access blocked apps.
